title: Sable Physics Tree
description:
Turns felled tree crowns into Sable physics objects, making tree cutting interact with physics instead of leaving
  static floating logs and leaves.
body:
Sable Physics Tree makes tree felling interact with Sable physics.

  When a tree is cut, the connected upper trunk and nearby leaves are assembled into a Sable physics object and given an
  initial falling impulse. Leaves decay over time, so the falling tree does not leave a permanent floating canopy
  behind.

  Requirements:

  - Minecraft 1.21.1
  - NeoForge
  - Sable
